name: Kiri
source:
When Kiri is possessed by Riri, her hair gain little more reddish color. 
Riri can also swapping between their appearances as she pleases. And color of their eyes changes depending who is currently in control of body.

[Translated from the [url=https://hamham-soft.net/imosucc/]official website[/url]]
